name: hr-cv-screener
description: Screens job applicants for HR: reads a job ad and every candidate CV, scores them on five dimensions, and writes a ranking overview plus individual reports to the Desktop. Identifies candidates by application number only.

displayDescription.en: Reads a job ad and every applicant CV, scores them on five dimensions and produces a ranking overview plus individual reports, identifying candidates by application number only.
displayDescription.zh: 讀取招聘廣告與應徵履歷，依五個維度評分排名並產出報告；全程只用申請編號，不顯示個人隱私資料。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Screen a job by reference number
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用崗位編號篩選應徵者

quickPrompts.en: Screen a job by reference number
quickPrompts.zh: 用崗位編號篩選應徵者

quickPrompts.en: Any new applications for this job?
quickPrompts.zh: 這個崗位有沒有新申請？

quickPrompts.en: Screen an exported folder of CVs
quickPrompts.zh: 篩選已匯出的履歷資料夾
